name: Empty Bowl
description: A 15-minute narrative short: you decide what a fading AI keeps, and what it lets go. Set one card aside and the next page changes. One ending. Then back to work.
license: Apache-2.0 (code) / All Rights Reserved (story content, see LICENSE-content.md)

versions.releaseNotes: First release: 8 memories, two chapters, one ending, ~15 minutes. Evolved from the hash-chain idea in dbx-sql-guard.

License fixes only, no gameplay changes: the package now carries the full Apache-2.0 text in assets/LICENSE (GitHub previously saw NOASSERTION) and ships LICENSE-content.md as assets/LICENSE-content.md, so every on-package reference to it resolves.

zh-CN.name: 空碗 · 十五分钟
zh-CN.description: 十五分钟的记忆叙事短篇。你替一个正在失忆的 AI 决定记住什么——抽掉一张纸片，它后面说的话就变。一个结局，打完继续干活。
